description: Bare `except:` that swallows all exceptions and returns None implicitly.
why_wrong: A bare except catches KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit, hiding real failures. The function is annotated `-> bool` but returns None on the exception path, so callers doing `if is_valid_email(x)` silently treat errors as invalid input.
